name: Marquee Band
use: Endless ticker band of big words with accent stars. The phrases come from a normal Text Block, and an optional outlined second band runs the other way.
notes: Over the 8 KB budget (9.5 KB unminified) because of six options plus Text Block parsing. Preview runs at ~270 px/s so one loop period fits in 5.9 s (snippet default 100 px/s). The GIF is rendered with aliased edges (MQ_CRISP=1) to fit under 2.5 MB; antialiased moving text produced ~4.5 MB. The MP4 and poster are antialiased.
